overall: The arm-level estimates in the text match the tables. Automated Flagging (+4.4), the AI Literacy Guide (+4.7) and Mindfulness (−3.9) are significant on accuracy at uncorrected p-values, and the pooled accuracy effect is null. The main caveat is that 44 registered tests were run with no correction, so the Guide (p = 0.043) and Mindfulness (p = 0.032) results are fragile. Some wording overreaches, notably that exploratory and uncorrected findings are described as raising or lowering outcomes, and the Key findings sentence on Breathing Exercise and the Accuracy Nudge omits the Guide. The pooled CIs are not tabulated but follow from the pooled estimate and SE.

issues.fix: Report the pooled estimate as 1.0 point (SE 0.7, p = 0.132), or add the CI to the table.
issues.disposition_reason: The pooled CI is derivable from the estimate and SE, so only reporting needs fixing.

issues.issue: The text gives the AI Literacy Guide CI as [0.04, 15.7]. The table shows [0.000, 0.157], so the lower bound is about 0.0 points, not 0.04. The p-value is 0.0488, consistent with a lower bound very near zero.
issues.disposition_reason: The H5 Guide CI lower bound should read 0.0 as in the table.
